$comment: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for per-lane agent backend routing. Runtime-dispatched lanes resolve lane -> route -> backend: the lane owns workflow identity, the route owns backend + fallback policy, and the backend profile owns adapter + provider + model. Editing one route backend re-routes every lane using it without workflow changes; point one lane at a different route to split it. Legacy harness=agent-run and harness=dispatch-default lanes are also runtime-resolved. harness=pi, harness=opencode, and harness=claude-code-action lanes remain CI-enforced mirrors. docs/backend-matrix.md and the README diagram are generated by scripts/build_backend_matrix.py.

claude.notes: Native Anthropic through claude-code-action OAuth; the served model is fallback.native_model (the --model opus alias resolves to it). Always considered available.

claude-opus-5.notes: Native Anthropic on the default dispatch generative lane and explicit opus-5 selector. It is deliberately absent from fallback.chain: a fallback should be the cheap reliable path.

opencode-deepseek-v4-flash.display_name: DeepSeek V4 Flash via OpenCode Go
opencode-deepseek-v4-flash.notes: OpenCode CLI inside run-opencode-container, authenticated by OPENCODE_API_KEY and pinned to opencode-go/deepseek-v4-flash. Runtime-selectable by agent-dispatch; not selectable by agent-run.

opencode-glm-5p3-flash.notes: OpenCode CLI inside run-opencode-container, authenticated by OPENCODE_API_KEY and pinned to the official opencode-go/glm-5.3-flash model id. Primary strict profile for the shared research-editorial route; not selectable by agent-run.

cursor-grok-4p6-fast.notes: Cursor Agent CLI inside run-cursor-container, authenticated by CURSOR_API_KEY and pinned to cursor-grok-4.6-high-fast (the CLI id for Grok 4.6 Fast; grok-4.6-fast is not a valid --model). Replaces composer-2.5. Runtime-selectable by agent-dispatch; not selectable by agent-run. Production editorial defaults stay on OpenCode until this profile is chosen in a route. cursor-composer-2p5 remains a compatibility alias.

research-editorial.notes: Primary isolated editorial route for RSS, Bluesky, and community. The arXiv and wiki lanes deliberately use research-editorial-secondary so one provider credential or plan cap cannot stale all five scheduled editorial lanes. Incompatible host-checkout adapters are rejected before execution; this route is fail-closed with no cross-adapter fallback.

research-editorial-secondary.notes: Secondary isolated editorial failure domain for arXiv and wiki. It uses a different adapter, provider credential, and billing plan from research-editorial while retaining the same isolated_workspace + editorial_contract capability gate. It fails closed rather than silently changing model provenance.

generative-translation.notes: Dedicated isolated route for Korean generative-research translation. It is separate from scheduled editorial traffic so translation quality/cost can be rerouted independently; publication stays host-owned and the route fails closed. Cursor Grok 4.6 Fast writes the fixed segment JSONL; OpenCode remains a compatible adapter if this route is pointed back.

fallback.notes: ORDERED fallback chain, globally applied to every non-strict agent-run lane. When the lane's requested provider probe fails, scripts/select_backend.py walks this chain in order (skipping the already-failed requested backend if it reappears) and runs the first candidate whose provider is available. Native Claude leads the chain and serves `native_model`. Z.ai GLM-5.2 is the second link, added after the 2026-07-24 outage: the chain was ["claude"] only AND probe_claude() hardcoded "always available", so an expired CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN took down every agent lane in the fleet at once with no route out (instant is_error, 1 turn, $0 cost) while ZAI_API_KEY sat configured and healthy. probe_claude() now reports down only on an explicit 401/403 credential rejection, so a rate limit, 5xx, or network blip still keeps the fleet on Claude. Lanes with "strict": true (zai-canary, the comparison tiers) never walk the chain — unavailability fails the run. `native_model` is the model served whenever the native claude path runs (also what the --model opus alias resolves to); raised from claude-sonnet-5 to claude-opus-5 on 2026-08-01, so every non-strict agent lane and the twitter-ab claude leg now run Opus 5 on the same OAuth subscription.

rss.notes: 2h RSS digest through the shared research-editorial route. One exact dated artifact is required; the lane fails closed with no deterministic fallback.

bluesky.notes: Daily Bluesky expert-commentary section through the shared research-editorial route; trusted host code validates the exact returned artifact and owns append/dedup/commit.

community.notes: HN + Reddit digests through the shared research-editorial route. Both exact dated artifacts are required; the lane fails closed with no deterministic fallback.

arxiv.notes: Daily arXiv sweep through the secondary isolated editorial route. The dated report is required and the companion summary is allowed; the lane fails closed with no deterministic fallback.

digest-synthesis.notes: Primary daily digest synthesis (MCP search path).

digest-synthesis-fallback.notes: Local-source digest synthesis when MCP keys are absent.

digest-audio-script.notes: Rewrites the digest summary as the ARA spoken TTS script.

wiki-ingest.notes: Digest -> LLM wiki page CRUD through the secondary isolated editorial route; writes stay under the wiki prefix and page deletion remains forbidden by the workflow guard.

generative-research-ko.notes: Automatic one-slug Korean translation after each production generative-research publication, with manual backfill still available. The isolated adapter returns one uncommitted draft; trusted host validators and the canonical writer own the immutable artifact pair, index mutation, and gated publication.

twitter-primary.notes: Primary 3h Twitter/X processor (tier slot named 'claude' for historical reasons).

twitter-primary-repair.notes: Claude-only repair writer for the primary Twitter/X tier when the first Claude pass returns without required files.

twitter-judge.notes: Headline-dedupe adjudication gate inside the primary tier (docs/headline-dedupe.md).

twitter-autoresearch.notes: Auto-research topic selection inside the primary tier.

twitter-deepseek.notes: 6h DeepSeek comparison tier. STRICT: comparison artifacts must be attributable to the labeled backend, so this lane never walks the fallback chain and has no automatic deterministic fallback.

twitter-zai.notes: Manual-default Z.ai comparison tier. STRICT: comparison artifacts must be attributable to Z.ai, so this lane never walks the fallback chain and has no automatic deterministic fallback.

zai-canary.notes: Z.ai provider diagnostics. PINNED to zai and STRICT (never walks the fallback chain): this lane exists to test Z.ai — a Z.ai outage must fail this run, not re-route it.

twitter-ab-claude.notes: A/B eval leg A: production native Claude (serves fallback.native_model). PINNED+STRICT: eval artifacts must be attributable to exactly this backend — any re-route contaminates the comparison (docs/twitter-model-ab.md).

twitter-ab-zai.notes: A/B eval leg B: GLM-5.2 via Z.ai Coding Plan. PINNED+STRICT: a Z.ai outage must FAIL this leg, never fall back to Claude — a silent fallback would make the eval Claude-vs-Claude (docs/twitter-model-ab.md).

twitter-ab-judge.notes: A/B eval blinded judge, pass 1. Native Claude with the workflow's native-model override to claude-opus-4-8 so the judge is a true non-contestant on a different model from the production fallback.native_model (claude-opus-5) leg A runs on.

twitter-ab-judge-swapped.notes: A/B eval blinded judge, pass 2 with A/B contents position-swapped (position-bias control). Same claude-opus-4-8 native-model override as twitter-ab-judge.

twitter-deepseek-pi.notes: Manual pi-harness comparison tier. MIRROR: model/provider live in the workflow step; CI enforces equality with this entry.

twitter-fireworks-pi.notes: Manual pi-harness Kimi comparison tier. MIRROR: CI enforces equality with the workflow step.

generative-research-default.notes: Default backend when neither the dispatch input nor an issue-label form specifies one. Runtime-resolved by the workflow's backend-resolution step. Claude Opus 5 is the premium native Anthropic generative route; consumers are manual dispatch with no backend input, gen-research-labelled issues, and hourly-twitter.yml's auto-research dispatch (throttled to <=2 per rolling 24h). The workflow pins the literal model ID and verifies committed article provenance before pushing. Explicit Sonnet Claude, Codex, Fireworks, OpenCode, Cursor, and evaluation selectors remain available.

generative-research-claude.notes: Model served on the backend=claude path (env-pinned in the workflow). MIRROR: CI enforces equality.

ai-news-research.notes: Twice-daily broad news sweep (MCP and no-MCP variants share the lane). MIRROR: CI enforces equality.

research-issue.notes: Issue-labeled deep research (MCP and no-MCP variants). MIRROR: CI enforces equality.

daily-improve.notes: Daily methodology-improvement PR agent. MIRROR: CI enforces equality.

claude-interactive.notes: @claude mentions in issues/PRs. MIRROR: CI enforces equality.

claude-code-review.notes: Automated PR review. MIRROR: CI enforces equality.

twitter-account-explorer.notes: Weekly account-curation PR agent. MIRROR: CI enforces equality.
